Gist of #2335: required outputs of a HUMAN_TASK (node attribute required_outputs: [keys]); completion-time check in run_complete_task answering retryable 422 naming missing keys, task stays open, no instance state change; out-of-enum value also retryable 422 instead of whole instance ERROR (REQ-061); adoption by shipped decision forms (swiftroute Shipment Approval ops_decision/ceo_decision; meridian l1/l2/ceo/kyc_outcome; vortex capacity/budget/severity) and replacement of Q-990's two KNOWN LIMITATION tests; start-form required instance-start variables (no start-form node exists: treat as OUT OF SCOPE here and record it as an open_question). Precedent: self_approval_forbidden in PromotionReviewStore.approve_review.

BINDING CONSTRAINTS from the design-intent owner (letflow-9a). Do not re-decide them.
A (distinct person): identity = USER ID, never the role; also holds for an API-token request (the token's user); enforce at COMPLETION as the authority and at CLAIM as early feedback; NO role exempt, TENANT_ADMIN included (TENANT_ADMIN exists after REQ-447); compare against the MOST RECENT completion of each named node in the same instance (rework loops work); the attribute is OPTIONAL and OFF by default (existing definitions unchanged); the REQ-455 validator WARNS (not a violation) when distinct_from names a node that routes to the same single-member role (could never complete); PROCESS-AUDITOR checklist item B1 (.claude/agents/process-auditor.md and its docs) may answer YES when the attribute is present: record that text change as a dependency/follow-up in open_questions, not part of the engine change.
C (required decision): the check runs on the SERVER BEFORE any state change; a form's `required` flag stays a UI hint, never the control; the validator also flags a decision (edge condition/gateway) reading a key that no upstream task declares in required_outputs; C ALSO folds in: out-of-enum value = retryable 422 and NO instance ERROR (today any task worker can put a whole instance into ERROR with one bad value); the refusal happens before anything is written (task stays open and claimable); the change of accepted behaviour is EXPLICIT: the C engine requirement's description must state the amendment of REQ-061's text (REQ-061, done, lists 'REQ-049's schema-violation-on-merge case' among callers of the ERROR sink) and DOC-UPDATER leaves a dated amendment pointer on REQ-061 as an acceptance criterion. Decision record docs/migration/decisions/0007-variable-merge-validates-new-keys.md: do NOT edit it. ORCH's finding for you to put in the C engine requirement's open_questions (verbatim passage plus proposed dated note, for REVIEWER sign-off per the decision-record rule): 0007 does not contradict validating every key, but its 'whole-batch-abort-on-rejection semantics (§3.2)' line (Implementation section, merge/3 bullet) and its open-question text 'validation errors surface only via `EXECUTION_ERROR` events today' become stale for the task-completion path. Proposed dated note: '2026-10 note (REQ-<C engine id>): on the HUMAN_TASK completion path a rejected output is now refused with a retryable 422 before any state change and no EXECUTION_ERROR is raised; merge/3 itself and its whole-batch semantics are unchanged; the EXECUTION_ERROR path remains for service-task and other engine-internal merges. REVIEWER sign-off: pending'. Quote the exact passages by reading the file.
